liquidity_sweep_reclaim.high_sweep_reclaim: current high > prior-window high AND current close <= prior-window high
liquidity_sweep_reclaim.low_sweep_reclaim: current low < prior-window low AND current close >= prior-window low

order_block.bullish: bullish displacement closes above prior-window high and previous candle is bearish
order_block.bearish: bearish displacement closes below prior-window low and previous candle is bullish

macd_divergence.bullish: second confirmed price low is lower while MACD histogram is higher
macd_divergence.bearish: second confirmed price high is higher while MACD histogram is lower
